  (hy : ∀ (f:Menu k) w (z:SmoothTests E)(c:ℝ), tsupport z.val⊆ r.stage w → Jet (stairs d Q) univ (composed (r.frame w) z).val c → ∀ n,Dust (r.beckon M T D i b f w z n) (L*c*r.bag d B w (generosity Q γ)* (dyad n)^γ*behind Q i f γ)) (hB:∀ w,0<B w): ∃ C >(0:ℝ), ∀ (f:Menu k) w (z:SmoothTests E)(c:ℝ), tsupport z.val⊆ r.stage w → Jet (stairs d Q) univ (composed (r.frame w) z).val c →
    Dust (r.select M T D i b f w (System.sliceAt P i.val (f i.val).slice (r.net i b w z))) (C*c*r.bag d B w (generosity Q γ)* shadow Q f γ):= by

proof_context.conclusion: Summing the shell bounds `L*c*bag*(dyad n)^γ*behind` over `n` with the geometric series `∑ (dyad n)^γ` bounds the whole arm by a constant times `c*bag*shadow`.

lemma seat {B : W→ℝ}(hB : ∀ w, 0<B w) (p : r.ramp i (outward b) u v) (f : Menu k):
    let a:= p.val.2/r.R i.val p.val.1;
    (r.renew i (outward b) u v he).bag d (r.promise i b u v B) p (generosity (replace i v.val) γ) * shadow (replace i v.val) (widenMenu v f) γ * tailPay b a ≤
       marginFactor r i (d:=d) * r.bag d B p.val.1 (generosity Q γ)* p.val.2 ^ γ * behind Q i f γ:= by

proof_context.conclusion: The factor `R^(-(γ+ε))` is absorbed into the parent's larger surcharge `generosity Q γ`.
